titles.title: Light Coming on the Plains No. I

description: Layers of arched blue shapes radiate out from a green, sun-like form at the bottom center of the abstract composition. Below the sun form are two horizontal bands of blue and green. Overall, the composition evokes a sun rising or setting over a horizon, giving off layers of light in a blue sky.
